title: NASA representative: 4,000 recorded cases a year

tellings.quote: when I talked with one of the NASA representatives, he says, "We officially record about 4,000 cases a year when people notice unidentified objects like saucers

plain: Kiran Ilum Xenov, introduced as the former president of a republic within Russia, says he was taken by aliens in 1997. He says that around then a representative of NASA, the US space agency, told him that they officially record about 4,000 cases a year of people seeing unidentified objects like saucers. If true, it would mean the agency quietly keeps a large count of such sightings.
